related_questions.question: What happens to an SBA COVID loan if the business closes?
related_questions.snippet: Generally speaking, so long as you wound down and liquidated the business and its assets properly, SBA said the loan will not need to be paid back, so long as it's under $200k. But if you had remaining business assets, you can't pocket it personally. You must pay back the loan, even if only partially.
